The discussion

Help useful work reach its next step.

Quick readMore contextTechnical detailSpeaker notes

Here is the whole talk in one breath. America can grow its innovation capacity by making it easier for three groups to get support, check their work, and put results into practice: independent researchers, open-source builders, and community organizations. Three priorities: access, capacity, learning. Everything else I say is an example of one of those three.
